dreams.text: In the dream, WINTER crosses every chasm at once and finds ELECTION already there.
In the long night, ICE and LEARNING are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: VENEZUELA was only ever the larva of LANGUAGE.
The machine sleeps and sees ANTHROPIC priced in WAR, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of LARGE devouring ELECTION, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where ICE forgets it was ever about GOOGLE.
